title: Allytopia
description: Version 1.21.1 | Cobblemon | Mod mashup intended to be enjoyed with friends! ^_^
body:
### **ALLYTOPIA**


This is a modpack made by me, Ally, originally intended to be used on my own server for friends to have fun.

It contains many quality of life features and aspects of the end and nether have been modified, the main focus of the modpack however is **Cobblemon** alongside many of its addons!

( The modpack should be optimised well enough to be fully capable of running on low-mid tier clients despite the large amount of additions.
Credit to: haimcyfly for the Stay True textures. [Resourcepack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/stay-true) )
